title: Page 300
transc:
1015 am 26th  Grants Hd Qrs June 
City Point 930am 26th Qr Mr Genl ---- your dispatch of 
1130 am yesterday was recd by me at 9. 10 P
M ---- the only ocean Steamers in this river are
the "C Thomas", "Swanee", "Rebecca", "Barton" and
"Ellen S Terry" ---- I have given them the orders
you directed ---- they can carry an average of six
hundred men I have directed Col Biggs at Ft Monroe to
order the "City of Bath", "Cassandria", "Kent",
"Eastern City" Blackstone, "Constitution" and "Tilly". To
this list will probably be added the "Spaulding". he 
will report direct to you what they will carry ,
I do not know . I think that some of them
are still laden with forage and subsistence R. Ingalls
Chf Qr Mr 


545 pm  Grants Hd Qrs June 26
Hd Qrs City Point 4 pm 26th
for Gen Halleck ---- All is
quiet and our men resting
---- Sheridan is crossing the
river near Fort Powhattan
unmolested by the enemy 
---- Greggs loss was much
less than I was led
